1.name: Opening Kickoff
1.ov: The 2024 season starts with a bang. As the LSU Tigers claw their way back to glory, the often overlooked South Carolina Gamecocks hope to stun the SEC.

1.name: QB1
1.ov: Drama brews in the Swamp when the Florida Gators and coach Billy Napier find themselves grappling with a slow start and a quarterback controversy.

1.name: Shock the World
1.ov: Vanderbilt has been the SEC's punching bag for years. Can they flip the script against #1 Alabama? The Arkansas Razorbacks face the Tennessee Volunteers.

1.name: Turning Point
1.ov: With a playoff spot at stake, LSU takes on longtime rivals Alabama. Auburn tries to salvage a disappointing season with an upset against Texas A&M.

1.name: Football Family
1.ov: After a string of losses, underdogs South Carolina hope to make a comeback. Keen to build on their winning streak, Vanderbilt hosts the Texas Longhorns.

1.name: Bragging Rights
1.ov: There's no shortage of bad blood when Mississippi State visits nemesis Ole Miss and Texas A&M battles their Austin rivals, the Texas Longhorns.

1.name: Just Win
1.ov: One Saturday is all that stands between 12 teams and a shot at the championship. South Carolina and Tennessee eye the playoffs; Kentucky plays for pride.
